why: The PR adds the @ifc-lite/flood-check package, so reverting production files removes the modules the tests import. Reverse application keeps every export but drops the rule that a placement alone is never an exact level: a door or window with no readable body or filled opening, and equipment with no body, then read as exact. The readability matrix and the earlier instances in test/level-quality.test.ts, which expect an upper estimate for every such row, go red.
